subject: Vendor onboarding — insurance exhibits & PO metadata questions
messages:
From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@novaprod.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor docs for onboarding / PO - initial packet

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. We want to get the PO moving ASAP; attaching what we have so far and a couple quick questions below.

What we attached: (see files uploaded to the portal and attached to this message)
- vendor_entity_form.pdf (completed)
- cyber-insurance-declaration.pdf (summary statement)

Questions:
1) For "additional insured" — do you need a specific endorsement PDF naming Redwood Inference, Inc. or will a COI with endorsement summary be acceptable initially?
2) Certificate holder — should it be the HQ address or the legal entity? Our COI lists our HQ; happy to change if needed.
3) PO metadata — what exact remit address, tax ID, and invoice email should we use (so we can map in our ERP)?
4) Is Redwood asking for waiver of subrogation and subcontractor disclosure for our subcontracted implementation partner?

We can pull endorsed forms from our broker; timeline depends on their turnaround but we can aim for 48–72 hours with a follow-up from our legal counsel if needed.

Appreciate any clarifications so we don't submit the wrong PDF and delay the PO.

Best,
Alex Novak
Head of Partnerships
Nova Products, Inc.
(Attachment: vendor_entity_form.pdf)
(Attachment: cyber-insurance-declaration.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@novaprod.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for onboarding / PO - initial packet

Thanks Alex — helpful start. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answers:
- Additional insured: we require an endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." with the policy endorsement PDF attached to the COI. A COI alone that indicates "additional insured by endorsement" is not sufficient for final activation.
- Certificate holder: please set to "Redwood Inference, Inc., 400 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105".
- Waiver of subrogation: required WHEN the work involves hosted integrations or access to customer data; please include if any access to our systems is planned.
- Subcontractor disclosure: list any subcontractors who will have data access.

Required items to move to a conditional PO:
1) Signed W‑9 (or certificate of foreign status)
2) COI with endorsement PDF naming Redwood Inference, Inc. and policy limits (GL, Professional Liability, Cyber if applicable)
3) Redlined vendor_entity_form completed and uploaded to procurement portal
4) Remit / billing contact and tax ID for PO metadata

I attached our standard insurance spec for reference (redwood-insurance-specs.pdf). Please upload all items to our vendor portal link in the procurement form (linked below). Once the portal confirms receipt we can issue a provisional PO while final endorsements are processed.

Portal & forms: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/procurement/vendor-intake-form
Procurement SLA: conditional PO within 48 hours of complete packet; final PO after endorsement receipt (typically 5–10 business days).

If you want, loop in your broker and I can have our procurement specialist (Ben) run a quick acceptance check before formal submission.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-insurance-specs.pdf)

From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@novaprod.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumensys-legal.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for onboarding / PO - initial packet

Got it — thanks for the clarity. Quick follow-ups from our side:

- We'll request the endorsement PDF from our broker and upload both the COI and endorsement.
- W‑9 will be attached by EOD tomorrow.
- Our broker confirmed that policy limits for GL and Professional Liability are in place; they wanted to know if a COI with policy limits plus separate endorsement is equivalent to a single document. Your spec looked like you prefer the endorsement file be attached as a discrete PDF — we'll provide both.

Priya from our legal team (cc'd) will handle the endorsement upload and subcontractor list. Two small asks:
1) Are provisional POs acceptable to start procurement while endorsement is pending? (You said conditional PO — can you confirm whether that includes expected PO number for invoicing?)
2) If the effective date on insurance is earlier than contract start, will that cause any issues for activation?

Thanks — we'll aim to have the W‑9 and endorsement by tomorrow / Wednesday.

Best,
Alex
(Attachment: — none in this message; broker is pulling endorsement)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@novaprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor docs for onboarding / PO - initial packet

Alex —
Quick confirmation on procurement side.

- Conditional PO: yes, we will issue a provisional PO number (format NOVA-####) which can be used for invoicing while we await the endorsement PDF. That PO will be converted to final once endorsements are accepted.
- Effective date: endorsements with effective dates earlier than contract start are fine; we just need coverage to be active on the contract start date.

Next steps for you: upload W‑9 and endorsement to the portal & reply to this thread when uploaded. I will then create provisional PO NOVA-1234 and share the PDF. Please reference that PO on your first invoice.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

—Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: provisional-po-NOVA-1234.pdf)
